description: This Python module implements an audio filter class `AICFilter` that integrates with the ai-coustics AIC SDK to perform real-time audio enhancement. It provides initialization, start, stop, processing of control frames, and filtering of audio frames, specifically designed for use within the Pipecat audio processing pipeline.

classes.name: AICFilter
classes.description: An audio filter utilizing the ai-coustics AIC SDK to provide real-time audio enhancement, with methods for initialization, starting, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data.

methods.name: get_vad_factory(self)
methods.description: Returns a factory function that creates a VAD instance bound to the underlying AIC model.

methods.name: create_vad_analyzer( self, *, lookback_buffer_size: Optional[float] = None, sensitivity: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a lazily-initialized VAD analyzer configured with optional lookback buffer size and sensitivity, using the AIC SDK.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes the AIC model with the given sample rate, creates model parameters, and logs diagnostic information.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Cleans up and closes the AIC model, resetting internal state and clearing buffers.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes control frames, such as enabling/disabling the filter, and updates model parameters accordingly.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Applies real-time audio enhancement by buffering input data, processing complete chunks with the AIC model, and returning enhanced audio bytes.

methods.name: None __init__( self, *, license_key: str = "", model_type: AICModelType = AICModelType.QUAIL_STT, enhancement_level: Optional[float] = 1.0, voice_gain: Optional[float] = 1.0, noise_gate_enable: Optional[bool] = True, )
